acceptance: `evolve doctor plane --repair` on a fixture hub whose directory moved restores the worktree links (red: flag provided but not defined)
Without --repair, a broken link is reported and the command exits 1
fix: Add `--repair` to `evolve doctor plane`. It lists the repository's worktrees, reports each one whose gitdir link is broken, runs `git worktree repair` over them and prints each repaired path. Without --repair, it reports broken links and exits 1 when any exist. Git I/O exits 2. Update workspace-layout.md.
source: console, 2026-09-30, core-function CLI inventory (operator request: a CLI request for each core function)
summary: workspace-layout.md:41 tells the operator to run `git --git-dir=.repo.git worktree repair <worktree paths>` after the hub is moved or copied. `evolve doctor plane` classifies one checkout, printing primary or linked, branch and gitdir (doctor_plane.go:16-45), but it neither detects broken worktree links nor repairs them.
title: After the hub moves, worktree links are repaired with raw `git worktree repair`; add `evolve doctor plane --repair`
